basic_details.job_title: IIMB Academic Associate Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: Indian Institute of Management Bangalore (IIMB) has released the recruitment notification for 1 Academic Associate vacancy on a contract basis, initially for a period of one year and extendable up to a maximum period of three years. Candidates applying for the post must hold a Master's degree in Statistics, Operations Research, or closely related field, or an MBA/PGDM. The all-inclusive monthly stipend ranges from Rs. 43,000 to Rs. 55,000 based on experience. Eligible applicants can apply online by filling out the application form and uploading mandatory documents through the provided link on

how_to_apply: Access the online application form through the official application link.
Fill in all mandatory fields in the application form.

Upload mandatory documents including 10th and 12th marksheets, diploma/graduation semester-wise marksheets and final degree certificate, and masters/post-graduation semester-wise marksheets and final degree certificate.
Submit the completed application form on or before 12 November 2026.

content_sections.heading: IIMB Academic Associate at a Glance

rows.details: Initially for one year, extendable up to 3 years
IIM Bangalore-Dorabji Tata School of Undergraduate Studies, Jigani, Bengaluru

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates must hold a Master’s degree in Statistics or Operations Research or a closely related field such as Industrial Engineering, Applied Math, or Scientific Computing. Additionally, an MBA or Post Graduate Diploma in Management (PGDM) equivalent to a master’s degree from a reputed business school will also be considered. The position is suited for candidates with excellent academic credentials who have a long-term interest in pursuing a doctoral program and engaging in teaching and research.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The selected candidate will receive an all-inclusive monthly stipend in the range of ₹ 43,000/- to ₹ 55,000/-, determined based on the applicant's experience. content_sections.heading: How to Apply for IIMB Academic Associate – Decision Sciences Area
content_sections.text: Access the online application form through the official application link. Fill in all mandatory fields in the application form. Upload mandatory documents including 10th and 12th marksheets, diploma/graduation semester-wise marksheets and final degree certificate, and masters/post-graduation semester-wise marksheets and final degree certificate. Submit the completed application form on or before 12 November 2026.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: The institute reviews submitted applications and performs shortlisting. Only shortlisted candidates will be intimated by the institute regarding further stages.

faq.question: Q1. Is the Academic Associate position permanent or on contract?
faq.answer: The position is offered on a contract basis, initially for a period of one year and extendable up to a maximum period of three years.

faq.question: Q2. How are candidates shortlisted for the position?
faq.answer: Candidates are shortlisted based on their academic credentials and application details, and only shortlisted applicants will be intimated by the institute.

faq.question: Q3. Who is not eligible for consideration?
faq.answer: Applicants who submit their applications without the mandatory documents, such as all semester-wise marksheets and final certificates for graduation and post-graduation, will have their applications treated as incomplete and will not be considered.

faq.question: Q4. Which documents are required to be uploaded during application submission?
faq.answer: Applicants must upload 10th and 12th marksheets, diploma or graduation all semester-wise marksheets along with the final diploma/degree certificate, and masters or post-graduation all semester-wise marksheets along with the final degree certificate.
